devils.one (formerly known as Team Kinguin) is a Polish esports organization sponsored by Kinguin.net, a CD key re-seller based in Hong Kong.

  • Show All
  • May 5th - Team Kinguin sign Maikelele, SKYTTEN, rain, ScreaM and fox. [1]
  • June 29th - Team Kinguin part ways with SKYTTEN. [2]
  • July 1st - Team Kinguin acquire dennis. [3]
  • July 23rd - Team Kinguin part ways with Dalito due to his VAC ban. [4]
  • September 11th - Team Kinguin' roster is acquired by Gamers2. [5]
  • June 7th - Team Kinguin sign Dobry&Gaming, a lineup consisting of: innocent, MICHU, SZPERO, mouz, MINISE, and Loord as coach. [6]
  • August 21st - Team Kinguin bench innocent and MINISE as they sign Furlan and rallen. [7]
  • August 31st - Team Kinguin release innocent and MINISE. [8][9]
  • May 6th - Team Kinguin part ways with Furlan and sign Hyper as his replacement. [10]
  • October 19th - Team Kinguin move Hyper to a substitute position and sign Kap3r. [11]
  • January 4th - Team Kinguin bench SZPERO and Kap3r as they sign fox and MUTiRiS. [12]
  • February 6th - Team Kinguin loan MICHU to Virtus.pro. [13]
  • March 12th - Team Kinguin bench fox and MUTiRiS as they sign TaZ, reatz and MINISE. [14]
  • March 22nd - MICHU is acquired by Virtus.pro. [15]
  • May 29th - Team Kinguin loan SZPERO and Kap3r to tomorrow.gg for a 1-month period. [16]
  • June 28th - SZPERO and Kap3r return from their loan following failed negotiations with tomorrow.gg to acquire the duo. [17]
  • August 6th - SZPERO is acquired by AGO Esports. [18]
  • October 19th - Team Kinguin loan Kap3r to AGO Esports on trial. [19]
  • December 18th - kap3r is acquired by AGO Esports. [20]
  • January 8th - Team Kinguin bench reatz. [21]
  • January 29th - Team Kinguin sign dycha on trial. [22]
  • February 19th - Team Kinguin rebrand to devils.one. [23]
  • April 30th - devils.one parts ways with their roster as the two parties were unable to come to an agreement on contracts. [24]
  • September 23rd - devils.one enter Counter-Strike 2 with the signing of lajtbitexe, a roster consisting of: suonko, PeTeRoOo, Frontsiderr, ZEMO, fanatyk, and karmazynsz, the latter as coach. [25]
  • November 5th - devils.one bench ZEMO following the player receiving a ban on FACEIT. [26]
  • November 19th - devils.one sign FENIX. [27]
  • February 15th - devils.one part ways with karmazynsz. [28]
  • April 4th - devils.one part ways with their lineup. [29]
